about_the_game:
Hunt of Dusha

You enter a residential complex where a curse has taken hold of the area.
As a Hunter, it is your duty to investigate the block, track the entities that haunt it, and cleanse the area of their presence. To lift the curse, you’ll need to confront them directly.

Features

Investigate the block – Explore a residential complex filled with twisting corridors, hidden rooms, and unsettling encounters.

Cleanse the curse – Perform purification rituals and confront the horrors that dwell within.

Cleansing rituals – Use weapons, charms, and forbidden techniques to weaken and banish the entities.

Atmospheric horror – Experience haunting retro-inspired visuals and sound design.

Event-based gameplay – Encounter randomized events and make crucial choices that affect your fate and statistics.
